potential applications of these advanced AI systems. Large language models, such as GPT-3,

intelligent chatbots, virtual assistants, and customer support systems that can understand
and respond to user inquiries with remarkable accuracy. The potential for enhancing user

breaking down language barriers and enabling effective communication on a global scale.
